🎬 Passion Fish (1992)

Passion Fish follows May-Alice Culhane, a successful television actress whose life changes dramatically after a devastating car accident leaves her paralyzed from the waist down. Forced to leave behind her glamorous career and return to her family’s home in Louisiana, May-Alice struggles with depression, anger, and the overwhelming challenges of adjusting to her new reality. Her difficult personality and refusal to accept help make it nearly impossible for caregivers to stay with her until Chantelle, a determined young woman with a troubled past, arrives to work as her nurse. Despite their initial disagreements and completely different backgrounds, the two women gradually develop an unexpected friendship built on honesty, understanding, and mutual respect. As they confront their personal struggles and painful memories, both discover the possibility of healing and finding happiness again. Starring Mary McDonnell, Alfre Woodard, David Strathairn, and Angela Bassett, the film delivers powerful performances and an emotional story about friendship, resilience, forgiveness, independence, and the courage to rebuild a life after tragedy.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Independent Film • Comedy-Drama

⭐ IMDb: 7.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: 2h 15m • R

🎥 Director: John Sayles

✍️ Writer: John Sayles

📚 Setting: Rural Louisiana, exploring the lives of two women whose unexpected friendship transforms their futures.

🏆 Awards: Nominated for two Academy Awards, including Best Actress for Mary McDonnell and Best Original Screenplay for John Sayles.
